question: Should acpx intentionally reject existing timeout and TTL inputs above Node’s timer ceiling rather than retaining the runtime’s historical 1 ms clamp?
rationale: The branch makes this behavior explicit and tests it, but users with already-accepted oversized values will encounter a new CLI or config validation error after upgrade.

options.title: Approve explicit validation
options.body: Accept the targeted compatibility change so impossible timer delays fail clearly instead of silently becoming a near-immediate timer.

options.title: Retain legacy acceptance
options.body: Preserve the prior accepted-input behavior and narrow the fix to positive durations that currently round into zero.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit validation
recommendation.body: Accept the targeted compatibility change so impossible timer delays fail clearly instead of silently becoming a near-immediate timer.
